name: RSVQA-LR A/B gate sample (EXP-002)
purpose: Fixed, deterministic single-image VQA sample for the G5A A/B reproduction gate. Used identically across RSCoVLM-3B, TinyRS-2B, Qwen2-VL-2B.

source_dataset.paper: Lobry et al., 'RSVQA: Visual Question Answering for Remote Sensing Data', IEEE TGRS 2020
source_dataset.acquisition: https://rsvqa.sylvainlobry.com/  (Zenodo 3945396). NOT downloaded from this host - multi-GB, see EXP-002 blocker log.

selection_policy.rationale: presence + comparison are yes/no -> balanced accuracy is well-defined; count/area are open-ended regression-like; rural_urban is 2-class but semantically different. Excluding them keeps the metric a clean binary balanced accuracy.
selection_policy.answer_normalisation: lower-case, strip, map {'yes'->1,'no'->0}; anything else -> discard question and log as MALFORMED_REFERENCE
selection_policy.class_balance_target: report actual yes/no counts; balanced accuracy corrects for imbalance

resolved_note: resolved_ids is populated by evaluation/scripts/exp002_ab_gate.py --resolve once LR_split_test_questions.json is present. Empty here because the dataset is not acquired (artifact-acquisition BLOCKED, see docs/research/EXP-002.md).

metric.threshold_kind: INTERNAL USABILITY THRESHOLD - not an official SIH scoring criterion
